roleTips.settler: Players take plantations in turn; the privilege may take a quarry instead.
roleTips.mayor: Distribute colonists from the colonist ship; the privilege takes 1 extra colonist.
roleTips.builder: Players may buy one building in turn; the privilege pays 1 doubloon less.
roleTips.craftsman: All players take goods from their occupied production chains; the privilege takes 1 extra.
roleTips.trader: Players may sell a good the trading house does not already have; the privilege earns 1 extra doubloon.
roleTips.captain: Players take turns loading matching goods onto ships for victory points; the privilege scores 1 extra VP.
roleTips.prospector: Only the role owner gains 1 doubloon.

buildingTips.smallIndigo: Produces indigo; each occupied circle processes 1 indigo.
buildingTips.smallSugar: Produces sugar; each occupied circle processes 1 sugar.
buildingTips.smallMarket: When selling a good, gain 1 extra doubloon.
buildingTips.hacienda: During the settler phase, you may first take 1 extra plantation from the top of the stack.
buildingTips.constructionHut: During the settler phase you may take a quarry, even if you are not the Settler.
buildingTips.smallWarehouse: At the end of the captain phase, you may keep 1 type of good.
buildingTips.hospice: When you take a plantation or quarry, place 1 colonist on it if the supply allows.
buildingTips.office: When selling, you may ignore the trading house's same-good restriction.
buildingTips.largeMarket: When selling a good, gain 2 extra doubloons.
buildingTips.largeWarehouse: At the end of the captain phase, you may keep 2 types of goods.
buildingTips.factory: During the craftsman phase, gain doubloons based on how many kinds of goods you produced.
buildingTips.university: When you build a building, place 1 colonist on it if the supply allows.
buildingTips.harbor: During the captain phase, score 1 extra victory point each time you load.
buildingTips.wharf: Once per captain phase, you may use your own virtual cargo ship.
buildingTips.guildHall: Game end: +1 VP per small production building; +2 VP per large production building.
buildingTips.residence: Game end: score based on occupied plantations and quarries.
buildingTips.customsHouse: Game end: 1 VP per 4 victory point chips.
buildingTips.cityHall: Game end: 1 VP per violet building (including City Hall).
